item.title: [UGLY] DSE Revokes Sonali Securities' Brokerage License
item.description:
Category: Ugly

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) has revoked the Trading Right Entitlement Certificate (TREC) of Sonali Securities Limited, effectively cancelling their brokerage license. This action was taken due to a serious violation of the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) rules, specifically Rule 3(2)(ga) of the Trading Right Entitlement Certificate Rules, 2020. This event highlights a serious breach of regulatory compliance and could erode investor confidence in the market's oversight mechanisms.

Why this matters: The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) cancelled a brokerage firm's license due to regulatory non-compliance, which is detrimental to market integrity.
